scheme_name: Scheme for Assistance to MSMEs for Market Development
other_conditions: Enterprise must have a Udyam Registration Certificate (URC) as per MSME Development Act 2006
Selection of MSME units is done by the Department of Industries and Commerce based on product profile, fair theme and relevance
Participation must be in Government/agency‑sponsored fairs or those approved by Export Promotion Councils
Preference is given to units that have not previously availed benefits under this scheme
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of up to ₹37,500 (or 75% of stall rent) for national/international fairs in Rajasthan, up to ₹1,12,500 for fairs elsewhere in India, and up to ₹1,50,000 for overseas fairs, subject to usage limits per financial year.
